The parity INVERTS at the end: idx 29 is the Hindi of Q39(a)(iv) + Q39(b) and idx 30 is ENGLISH-ONLY (Q39(a)(iv) with its figure, OR, Q39(b)), confirmed at full size. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Sections by discipline as instruction (ii) prints: A Biology Q1-16 (30), B Chemistry Q17-29 (25), C Physics Q30-39 (25); every printed per-question mark matches sci80_2026. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-9, every footer reads 31/2/1) for a bare OR: Q10, Q15(c), Q16, Q26, Q28(c), Q29, Q34, Q38(c), Q39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. The scheme's OR inside Q8's answer cell is a dual key, not an alternative. Section MCQ keys (Q1-9, Q17-24, Q30-32) are CBSE's own, read off the scheme images. Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q33: 1{\cdot}732; Q37 table). Assertion-Reason options reused byte-for-byte from 2025 31/3/1 after reading them on this page; the A-R instruction is reworded per block (Questions 8 and 9; Question 24; Question 32). No sibling 2026 set committed yet, so nothing was skipped.
